item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod rgyud las zhi dbang rin chen phra rgyan mdzes pa
item.coloph: 'od ldan mkha' 'gros g.yung drung rtsal la brgyud/ gab pa bcas te g.yung drung dbang la babs/ gyer spungs bka' ste g.yung drung bon gyi bstan/ nyi zer sa yi rdul bzhin dar rgyas shog/
